title: The Loss or the Architecture? What Matters in Survival Analysis with Competing Risks
abstract: arXiv:2610.23322v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Often, \emph{eg} in healthcare and predictive maintenance, what matters is which of several competing causes will strike first, and with what probability: survival analysis with competing risks. Corresponding deep learning methods are developed as bundles: a new architecture together with a new training loss, tested on one to five datasets against a handful of baselines. Thus, a state-of-the-art result cannot be attributed to the architecture, the loss, or the evaluation protocol. The coupling is not accidental: with one incidence curve per cause, a network's head is tied to the losses expressible on it. We vary the two axes independently, three losses, two of them strictly proper, on four backbones, across two modalities that tease the axes apart: 20 tabular and 3 pathology-image datasets. translated_title: 损失函数还是网络架构？竞争风险生存分析中什么更重要
translated_abstract: 通常情况下，例如在医疗保健和预测性维护中，人们关心的是多个相互竞争的原因中哪一个会最先发生，以及其发生的概率：这就是竞争风险生存分析。相应的深度学习方法往往是作为“捆绑组合”开发的：一个新架构搭配一个新的训练损失函数，仅在一到五个数据集上与少数基线方法进行测试。因此，最先进的结果无法被归因于架构、损失函数还是评估协议。这种耦合并非偶然：由于每个竞争原因对应一条发生率曲线，网络的输出头与可在其上表达的损失函数是绑定在一起的。我们将这两个维度独立地进行变化：三种损失函数（其中两种是严格适当的）搭配四种骨干网络，跨越两种能够将这两个维度区分开的模态：20个表格数据集和3个病理图像数据集。有一种损失函数在两种模态中都胜出：即在删失加权下直接对累积发生率进行建模。它带来的收益是好骨干网络选择的两倍。
tldr: 该论文将损失函数与网络架构解耦并独立评估，在20个表格和3个病理图像数据集上发现：在删失加权下直接建模累积发生率的损失函数比选择更好的骨干网络带来更大的收益。
en_tdlr: By independently varying losses and backbones across 20 tabular and 3 pathology-image datasets, this paper shows that directly modeling cumulative incidence under censoring weighting is the loss that wins, bringing twice the benefit of a good backbone choice in competing-risks survival analysis.
